title: POL-254: policy governing the Vendor Portal
body:
Status

Status of this policy: in draft. Issued by Sofia Russo on 9 December 2025; 24
exceptions are on file with Finance Operations and expire at the yearly audit.

Scope

Policy POL-254 covers the Vendor Portal and is in draft, per the policy
register. Silverline Data audits compliance with the controls listed here each
year on behalf of the owner, Noah Fischer from Finance Operations.

Requirements

As of the 10 September 2025 review the requirements are:
- Report a suspected security incident within one hour of noticing it
- Retain audit logs for at least thirteen months
- Tag every cloud resource with an owner and a cost centre
